The '''attack on the Kashyyyk outpost''' was a battle which occurred on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] attacked an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] outpost on the planet. Flying as [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon Vander's]] [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]], [[Hol Okand/Legends|Hol Okand]] used his [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] to bring down the outpost's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].
